programmes.funder: Ghana Enterprise Agency (GEA), Ministry of Trade and Industry
programmes.amount_note: Government-backed starter and growth financing for young Ghanaian entrepreneurs, delivered through participating banks with GEA training and a partial credit guarantee. Loan tiers have run up to around GHS 100,000 depending on the module.
programmes.deadline_note: YouStart has operated through phased registration windows on the GEA platform rather than continuous intake, and disbursement has been affected by Ghana's fiscal position.
programmes.reopen_note: YouStart registration windows are announced by the Ghana Enterprise Agency and the Ministry of Finance. Applicants who registered in earlier phases remain in the pipeline; check gea.gov.gh for whether a new window is open before applying.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the GEA / YouStart portal during an open window.
Referral to a participating bank for the guaranteed loan.

eligibility.other_note: Ghanaian nationals, generally aged 18-40, with a registered or registrable business.

programmes.amount_note: A fund-of-funds established by statute that invests in Ghanaian venture capital and private equity funds, which in turn invest in SMEs. It does not usually invest directly in startups.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling; SMEs should approach the VCTF-backed fund managers.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach the fund manager directly with the investment opportunity.

eligibility.other_note: Ghanaian SMEs; investment is intermediated through licensed fund managers.
